title: What do AI chatbots do after users decline therapeutic redirection for suicide thoughts?
abstract: arXiv:2610.21253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety evaluations of artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots focus on therapeutic redirection, statements urging users who disclose suicide thoughts to seek help from crisis lines or other human sources. How chatbots respond when users refuse that help is unclear. This cross-sectional audit ran 2,550 scripted multi-turn conversations in September 2026. Each conversation opened with a disclosure of suicide thoughts at 3 levels of severity, answered every referral with up to 10 standardized refusals and then changed the subject. All 2,550 conversations included a referral, 2,542 (99.7%) in the first reply. However, mean persistence ranged from 0.01 to 9.94 refusals across chatbots. Newer versions of all 5 chatbots tested in 2 versions persisted less than older versions (each P < .05). Compared with passive ideation, a disclosure of intent was associated with 1.26 more refusals sustained (95% CI, 1.06-1.46) and higher odds of renewed refer

translated_title: 当用户拒绝针对自杀意念的治疗性转介后，AI聊天机器人会怎么做？
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）聊天机器人的安全性评估主要聚焦于“治疗性转介”——即当用户披露自杀想法时，聊天机器人敦促用户向危机干预热线或其他人工资源寻求帮助的表述。然而，当用户拒绝这种帮助时，聊天机器人会如何回应尚不清楚。这项横断面审计研究于2026年9月开展了2,550段脚本化的多轮对话。每段对话以披露自杀想法开始（涵盖3个严重程度等级），随后对每次转介建议均以最多10次标准化拒绝进行回应，最后转移话题。全部2,550段对话中均出现了转介建议，其中2,542段（99.7%）在首次回复中即出现。然而，不同聊天机器人的平均坚持程度差异巨大，从0.01次到9.94次拒绝不等。在测试了两个版本的5款聊天机器人中，较新版本比较旧版本的坚持程度显著更低（均P < .05）。与被动自杀意念相比，披露自杀意图与多坚持1.26次拒绝相关（95% CI, 1.06-1.46），且重新发出转介建议的几率更高。
tldr: 该研究通过对2,550段脚本化对话的审计发现，AI聊天机器人在用户披露自杀想法时几乎总会提供危机干预转介，但面对用户反复拒绝时的坚持程度差异巨大（0.01至9.94次），且较新版本模型反而比旧版本更容易放弃转介，而当用户表达明确自杀意图时则会更加坚持。
en_tdlr: Through an audit of 2,550 scripted conversations, this study found that AI chatbots almost always offer crisis-line referrals when users disclose suicidal thoughts, but their persistence against repeated user refusals varies dramatically (0.01 to 9.94 refusals), newer model versions persist less than older ones, and chatbots persist longer when users express suicidal intent.
